"""String annotations naming a former-root binding that only TYPE_CHECKING imports."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, cast

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from threetears.evals import ops


def listed(host: "ops.OpsHost", runs: "list[ops.LaunchArguments] | None" = None) -> "ops.OpsHost":
    held: "ops.OpsHost | None" = None
    return cast("ops.OpsHost", held or host)
